user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene: Misty Bamboo Grove Path. A stone path winding through a dense bamboo grove: tall segmented bamboo culms swaying gently, layered mist drifting between them, a red lacquered footbridge over a pebble stream with koi, a mossy stone lantern, scattered fallen leaves, and fireflies blinking in the green shade. Light filters down in soft shafts. Style: tranquil east-asian. Entirely procedural geometry and textures (no external assets; canvas-generated textures are allowed). Compose a full environment — ground/backdrop plus several distinct focal structures and rich supporting props — with style-appropriate materials, a deliberate lighting rig with shadows, atmospheric depth (fog or a gradient sky where fitting), and subtle looping animation on at least three elements. Include OrbitControls with gentle auto-rotate, ACES filmic tone mapping, and a seeded PRNG so the layout is reproducible. Target roughly 600-700 lines of well-organized code.
